claims.text: The data augmentation strategy is called Antecedent-free augmentation (afa), which involves modifying the gender of the German translation of coreferential pronouns in sentences where the antecedent is not present.
Candidates for augmentation are identified as sentences where a coreferential 'it' refers to an antecedent not present in the current or previous sentence.
The augmentation creates new training examples by changing the gender of the pronoun in the German translation while keeping the source side the same.
